title: Pendant Alert Test Reliability Incident Rate
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pendant:test
| where incident_count=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(incident_count) as incidents by _time pendant_id
| where incidents>0
| sort - _time
description: Tracks service incidents, faults, or problem reports for pendant alert test reliability by month.
value: Incident counts show which aid or device is quietly becoming unreliable, even before it fully fails.
implementation: Count any breakdown, missed alert, jam, or user-reported problem into `incident_count` during ingest.
visualization: Monthly table of incidents by device.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which pendant alert test reliability devices are causing repeated trouble.
